paragraphs.text: Βίβλος λόγων δικαιοσύνης καὶ ἐπιτίμησις τῶν Ἐγρηγόρων τῶν ἀπ' αἰῶνος κατὰ τὴν ἐντολὴν τοῦ ἁγίου τοῦ μεγάλου ἐν τῷ ὁράματι ἐκείνῳ ᾧ εἶδον.
paragraphs.translit: Biblos logōn dikaiosynēs kai epitimēsis tōn Egrēgorōn tōn ap' aiōnos kata tēn entolēn tou hagiou tou megalou en tō horamati ekeinō hō eidon.

i18n.en: The book of the words of righteousness, and of the rebuke of the Watchers from of old, according to the command of the Holy Great One — in that vision which I saw.

paragraphs.text: ἐν τῷ ὁράματί μου τούτῳ θεωρῶ ὅτι νέφος ἐκάλυπτέν με, καὶ ὁμίχλη με ἐκάλυπτεν, καὶ ἀστὴρ διώδευεν διὰ τῆς ἀτμίδος, καὶ ἀστραπαὶ καὶ βρονταὶ ἐσπούδαζόν με.
paragraphs.translit: en tō horamati mou toutō theōrō hoti nephos ekalypten me, kai homichlē me ekalypten, kai astēr diōdeuen dia tēs atmidos, kai astrapai kai brontai espoudazon me.

i18n.en: In this my vision I beheld: a cloud was covering me, and a mist was covering me, and a star was passing through the vapor, and flashes of lightning and peals of thunder were urging me on.

paragraphs.text: καὶ οἱ ἄνεμοι ἐν τῷ ὁράματί μου τοῦ ἐνυπνίου ἐπτέρωσάν με καὶ ἐπῆράν με ἄνω, καὶ εἰσήνεγκάν με εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν.
paragraphs.translit: kai hoi anemoi en tō horamati mou tou enypniou epterōsan me kai epēran me anō, kai eisēnenkan me eis ton ouranon.

i18n.en: And in my vision, the winds gave me wings, and they bore me upward, and they brought me into heaven.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ εἰσῆλθον, ἕως ἤγγισα ἐπὶ τοῖχον, ὁκοδομημένον ἐν λίθοις χαλάζης, καὶ γλῶσσαι πυρὸς κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἤρξατο ἐκφοβεῖν με.
paragraphs.translit: Kai eisēlthon, heōs ēngisa epi toichon, ōkodomēmenon en lithois chalazēs, kai glōssai pyros kyklō autou, kai ērxato ekphobein me.

i18n.en: And I went in, until I drew near to a wall that was built of stones of hail, and tongues of fire encircled it; and it began to fill me with fear.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὰς γλώσσας τοῦ πυρός, καὶ ἤγγισα εἰς οἶκον μέγαν ὁκοδομημένον ἐν λίθοις χαλάζης, καὶ οἱ τοῖχοι τοῦ οἴκου ἐκείνου ὡς λιθόπλακες, καὶ πᾶσαι ἦσαν ἐκ χιόνος, καὶ τὰ ἐδάφη χιών.
paragraphs.translit: Kai eisēlthon eis tas glōssas tou pyros, kai ēngisa eis oikon megan ōkodomēmenon en lithois chalazēs, kai hoi toichoi tou oikou ekeinou hōs lithoplakes, kai pasai ēsan ek chionos, kai ta edaphē chiōn.

i18n.en: And I entered into the tongues of fire, and I drew near to a great house, built of stones of hail; and the walls of that house were as slabs of stone, and they were all of snow, and the floor was of snow.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ τὰ στεγάσματα ἦν ὡς διοδεύοντες ἀστέρες καὶ ἀστραπαί, καὶ μέσον αὐτῶν Χερουβὶν πυρὸς, καὶ ὁ οὐρανὸς αὐτῶν ὕδωρ.
paragraphs.translit: Kai ta stegasmata ēn hōs diodeuontes asteres kai astrapai, kai meson autōn Cheroubin pyros, kai ho ouranos autōn hydōr.

i18n.en: And the ceilings were as the passing stars and lightnings, and in their midst were cherubim of fire, and their heaven was water.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ πῦρ φλεγόμενον ἦν κύκλῳ τοῖχον αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἡ θύρα ἐκαίετο πυρί.
paragraphs.translit: Kai pyr phlegomenon ēn kyklō toichon autou, kai hē thyra ekaieto pyri.

i18n.en: And a flaming fire encircled its walls, and the door blazed with fire.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὸν οἶκον ἐκεῖνον, καὶ ἦν θερμὸς ὡς πῦρ καὶ ψυχρὸς ὡς χιών, καὶ οὐκ ἦν τέρψις ζωῆς ἐν αὐτῷ· φόβος μου ἐκάλυψέν με, καὶ τρόμος με ἔλαβεν.
paragraphs.translit: Kai eisēlthon eis ton oikon ekeinon, kai ēn thermos hōs pyr kai psychros hōs chiōn, kai ouk ēn terpsis zōēs en autō; phobos mou ekalypsen me, kai tromos me elaben.

i18n.en: And I entered into that house, and it was hot as fire and cold as snow; and there was no delight of life within it. Fear covered me, and trembling took hold of me.

paragraphs.commentary: **The 1 Enoch 14 throne-vision begins** — Enoch's ascent through clouds and mist and wind into the cosmic-realm. See central entry `enoch-throne-vision-14-cross-corpus-ezek-1-dan-7-rev-4-shiur-qomah-four-tradition-wire` — the **first 4-tradition throne-vision wire in the WoH-Translation glossary**, extending the existing 3-tradition wire (Ezek 1 → Dan 7 → Hekhalot-Shi'ur Qomah → Rev 1+4) by inserting 1 Enoch 14 as the developmental bridge. Halperin 1988 *The Faces of the Chariot* documents 1 En 14 as the textual fountainhead of the merkavah-mystical tradition.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ σειόμενος καὶ τρέμων ἔπεσον ἐπὶ πρόσωπόν μου, καὶ ἐθεώρουν ἐν τῷ ὁράματί μου, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄλλος οἶκος μείζων τούτου, καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ θύραι ἀνεωγμέναι ἐνώπιόν μου, καὶ ὁκοδομημένος ἐν γλώσσαις πυρός.
paragraphs.translit: Kai seiomenos kai tremōn epeson epi prosōpon mou, kai etheōroun en tō horamati mou, kai idou allos oikos meizōn toutou, kai pasai hai thyrai aneōgmenai enōpion mou, kai ōkodomēmenos en glōssais pyros.

i18n.en: And quaking and trembling, I fell upon my face; and I beheld in my vision, and behold, there was another house, greater than this, and all its doors were open before me, and it was built of tongues of fire.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ἐν παντὶ ὑπερεῖχεν ἐν δόξῃ καὶ ἐν τιμῇ καὶ ἐν μεγαλωσύνῃ ὥστε ἀδύνατόν με ὑμῖν ἐκδιηγήσασθαι περὶ τῆς δόξης καὶ τῆς μεγαλωσύνης αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Kai en panti hyperechen en doxē kai en timē kai en megalōsynē hōste adynaton me hymin ekdiēgēsasthai peri tēs doxēs kai tēs megalōsynēs autou.

i18n.en: And in all things it so excelled in glory and honor and majesty that I cannot recount to you its glory and its majesty.

paragraphs.commentary: The **first house** of the two-house cosmography: crystal-floors, fiery walls, cherubim-decorated ceiling. The two-house architecture of 1 En 14 establishes the cosmographic-template that the Hekhalot-Merkavah tradition extends into the seven-heavens / seven-palaces (hekhalot) cosmography of Hekhalot Rabbati. Halperin 1988 documents the 1 En 14 → Hekhalot-tradition genealogy.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ τὸ ἔδαφος ἦν πυρός, καὶ τὰ ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ ἀστραπαὶ καὶ διοδεύοντες ἀστέρες, καὶ τὰ στεγάσματα αὐτοῦ πῦρ φλεγόμενον.
paragraphs.translit: Kai to edaphos ēn pyros, kai ta epanō autou astrapai kai diodeuontes asteres, kai ta stegasmata autou pyr phlegomenon.

i18n.en: And its floor was of fire, and above it were lightnings and passing stars, and its ceiling was of flaming fire.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ἐθεώρουν, καὶ εἶδον ἐν αὐτῷ θρόνον ὑψηλόν, καὶ τὸ εἶδος αὐτοῦ ὡσεὶ κρύσταλλος, καὶ ὁ τροχὸς ὡς ἥλιος λάμπων, καὶ φωνὴ Χερουβίν.
paragraphs.translit: Kai etheōroun, kai eidon en autō thronon hypsēlon, kai to eidos autou hōsei krystallos, kai ho trochos hōs hēlios lampōn, kai phōnē Cheroubin.

i18n.en: And I beheld, and I saw therein a lofty throne; and its appearance was as of crystal, and its wheel was as the shining sun, and there was the voice of cherubim.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ὑποκάτωθεν τοῦ θρόνου ἐξεπορεύοντο ποταμοὶ πυρὸς φλεγομένου, καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνάμην ἰδεῖν.
paragraphs.translit: Kai hypokatōthen tou thronou exeporeuonto potamoi pyros phlegomenou, kai ouk ēdynamēn idein.

i18n.en: And from beneath the throne came forth rivers of flaming fire, and I could not look upon it.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ἡ δόξα ἡ μεγάλη ἐκάθητο ἐπ' αὐτῷ, τὸ περιβόλαιον αὐτοῦ ὡς εἶδος ἡλίου λάμπον, καὶ λευκότερον πάσης χιόνος.
paragraphs.translit: Kai hē doxa hē megalē ekathēto ep' autō, to peribolaion autou hōs eidos hēliou lampon, kai leukoteron pasēs chionos.

i18n.en: And the Great Glory was seated upon it; his raiment was as the appearance of the shining sun, and whiter than any snow.

paragraphs.commentary: The **second-and-greater house** of the two-house cosmography — described in stacked precious-substance and fire-and-snow similes, anticipating the Shi'ur Qomah cosmic-body-of-divine register (see existing v2.59.0 `shiur-qomah-cosmic-body-of-divine-hekhalot-throne-vision-tradition`). Cherubim are explicitly invoked — extending the central entry `chayyot` to include the 1 En 14 cherubim refIds.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ οὐδεὶς τῶν ἀγγέλων οὐκ ἠδύνατο εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦτον καὶ ἰδεῖν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ διὰ τὸ ἔντιμον καὶ ἔνδοξον, καὶ οὐκ ἠδύνατο πᾶσα σὰρξ ἰδεῖν αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: Kai oudeis tōn angelōn ouk ēdynato eiselthein eis ton oikon touton kai idein to prosōpon autou dia to entimon kai endoxon, kai ouk ēdynato pasa sarx idein auton.

i18n.en: And none of the angels could enter into that house, nor look upon his face, by reason of its honor and glory; and no flesh could behold him.

paragraphs.text: Πῦρ φλεγόμενον ἦν κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ, καὶ πῦρ μέγα ἑστήκει ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ, καὶ οὐδεὶς οὐκ ἤγγιζεν αὐτῷ ἐκ τῶν κυκλούντων αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: Pyr phlegomenon ēn kyklō autou, kai pyr mega hestēkei enōpion autou, kai oudeis ouk ēngizen autō ek tōn kykloutōn auton.

i18n.en: Flaming fire encircled him, and a great fire stood before him, and none of those who surrounded him drew near to him.

paragraphs.text: Μύριαι μυριάδες ἑστήκασιν ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ, καὶ πᾶς λόγος αὐτοῦ ἔργον.
paragraphs.translit: Myriai myriades hestēkasin enōpion autou, kai pas logos autou ergon.

i18n.en: Ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him, and every word of his is deed.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ οἱ ἅγιοι ἄγγελοι αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ τίμιοι οὐκ ἀφίσταντο νυκτὸς οὐδὲ ἡμέρας ἑστηκότες ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Kai hoi hagioi angeloi autou kai hoi timioi ouk aphistanto nyktos oude hēmeras hestēkotes enōpion autou.

i18n.en: And his holy angels and the honored ones did not depart by night or by day, standing before him.

paragraphs.commentary: The **throne-of-the-Great-Glory** at the heart of the second house. *hē megalē doxa* 'the Great Glory' is the apophatic-divine-circumlocution title characteristic of 1 Enoch — see overlay entry `holy-great-one-great-glory-divine-circumlocution-titles-convention`. The throne with wheels-of-shining-sun directly parallels Dan 7:9-10 (the Ancient of Days' throne-of-flames-of-fire with wheels-of-burning-fire) — the closest two parallels in all Second-Temple apocalyptic literature; the scholarly question of relative-dating and direction-of-influence between Dan 7 and 1 En 14 is genuinely contested (Nickelsburg 2001 + Collins 1993 Hermeneia *Daniel*).

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ἐγὼ ἤμην ἕως τότε ἐπὶ προσώπου μου τρέμων, καὶ εἶπεν ὁ κύριος τοῖς χείλεσιν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἤκουσα αὐτοῦ τὴν φωνήν· Μὴ φοβοῦ, Ἑνὼχ ἄνθρωπε ἀληθινὲ καὶ γραμματεὺ τῆς ἀληθείας, πρόσελθε ὧδε καὶ ἄκουσον τὴν φωνήν μου.
paragraphs.translit: Kai egō ēmēn heōs tote epi prosōpou mou tremōn, kai eipen ho kyrios tois cheilesin autou, kai ēkousa autou tēn phōnēn; Mē phobou, Henōch anthrōpe alēthine kai grammateu tēs alētheias, proselthe hōde kai akouson tēn phōnēn mou.

i18n.en: And until then I was on my face, trembling; and the Lord spoke with his lips, and I heard his voice: Fear not, Enoch, you man of truth and scribe of truth — draw near here, and hear my voice.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ προσελθὼν εἷς τῶν ἁγίων πρὸς ἐμὲ ἤγειρέν με καὶ ἔστησέν με ἐπὶ τοὺς πόδας, καὶ προσῆξεν ἕως τῆς θύρας· καὶ ἐγὼ τὸ πρόσωπόν μου κάτω ἔνευον.
paragraphs.translit: Kai proselthōn heis tōn hagiōn pros eme ēgeiren me kai estēsen me epi tous podas, kai prosēxen heōs tēs thyras; kai egō to prosōpon mou katō eneuon.

i18n.en: And one of the Holy Ones came to me, and raised me up, and set me upon my feet, and brought me near to the door; and I had my face bent downward.

paragraphs.commentary: The face of the Great Glory cannot be looked upon — the apophatic-distance of the throne-figure, parallel to the Sinai-tradition prohibition on seeing-the-face-of-God (Ex 33:20). The hands-covered-by-the-cherubim and the indirect-perception of the throne-figure are throne-vision-tradition standard features inherited by the Hekhalot-Merkavah corpus.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ὁ κύριος τῷ στόματι αὐτοῦ ἐκάλεσέν με καὶ εἶπέν μοι· Ἔγγισον ὧδε, Ἑνὼχ, καὶ τῷ λόγῳ μου τῷ ἁγίῳ.
paragraphs.translit: Kai ho kyrios tō stomati autou ekalesen me kai eipen moi; Engison hōde, Henōch, kai tō logō mou tō hagiō.

i18n.en: And the Lord called me with his own mouth and said to me: Draw near here, Enoch, and hear my holy word.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ἤγειρέν με καὶ ἤγγισέν με ἕως τῆς θύρας· καὶ ἐγὼ τὸ πρόσωπόν μου κάτω ἔνευον.
paragraphs.translit: Kai ēgeiren me kai ēngisen me heōs tēs thyras; kai egō to prosōpon mou katō eneuon.

i18n.en: And he raised me up, and brought me near to the door; and I kept my face bent downward.

paragraphs.commentary: The **myriads of attendants** before the throne (*myriai myriadōn estēkesan enōpion autou*) directly parallel Dan 7:10 *ʾelep̄ ʾalp̄în yĕšammĕšūnēh wĕ-ribbô ribbĕwān qāḏāmōhî yĕqūmūn* — and prefigure Rev 5:11 *kai ho arithmos autōn myriades myriadōn kai chiliades chiliadōn*. Bidirectional with central entry `jude-14-15-quote-1-enoch-1-9-nt-citation-cross-corpus` (the myriads-of-holy-ones theophany-imagery is the source-chain shared with the Jude 14-15 quotation of 1 En 1:9).

paragraphs.text: Καὶ οἱ ἅγιοι ἄγγελοι αὐτοῦ ἀναρίθμητοι παριστάμενοι ἐν ταῖς πύλαις ἑστήκασιν ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Kai hoi hagioi angeloi autou anarithmētoi paristamenoi en tais pylais hestēkasin enōpion autou.

i18n.en: And his holy angels, beyond number, stood at the gates, standing before him.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ἕως τότε ἤμην ἐπὶ προσώπου μου σκεπασμένος καὶ τρέμων· καὶ ἐκάλεσέν με ὁ κύριος τῷ στόματι αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπέν μοι· Πρόσελθε ὧδε, Ἑνώχ, καὶ τῷ λόγῳ μου τῷ ἁγίῳ.
paragraphs.translit: Kai heōs tote ēmēn epi prosōpou mou skepasmenos kai tremōn; kai ekalesen me ho kyrios tō stomati autou kai eipen moi; Proselthe hōde, Henōch, kai tō logō mou tō hagiō.

i18n.en: And until then I had been on my face, covered and trembling; and the Lord called me with his own mouth and said to me: Draw near here, Enoch, and hear my holy word.

paragraphs.text: Καὶ ἤγειρέν με καὶ προσήνεγκεν ἕως τῆς θύρας· καὶ ἐγὼ τὸ πρόσωπόν μου κάτω ἔνευον.
paragraphs.translit: Kai ēgeiren me kai prosēnenken heōs tēs thyras; kai egō to prosōpon mou katō eneuon.

i18n.en: And he raised me up, and brought me near to the door; and I kept my face bent downward.
